places.name: Concourse C Food Court
places.description: Features several quick-service options including Bantam + Biddy, Great Wraps, and Sweet Georgia's Juke Joint. A fantastic setup because it has TVs for sports games and plenty of normal tables to sit and eat comfortably.

places.name: Concourse F
places.description: The newest and most spacious concourse at ATL. It acts as a phenomenal quiet spot to escape the usual hustle and bustle, especially when the international flights aren't going out.
